interpretation: Magnetic Q increases with mutual cross terms if signs and AC current phases reinforce stored energy.
Increasing magnetic Q at fixed coil RMS currents increases stored reactive energy at same ohmic loss; this does not lower power loss directly unless current changes.
For area4.333 B28 803 MHz even coil ohmic loss is 0.001257mW smaller at saturated k, but delivered load power falls and IL increases by 0.00619dB due aggregate matching/non-coil changes.
Saturation hurts mandatory harmonic rejection at unchanged C from previously executed EXP-043 global-band sensitivity, and reoptimization of C/L at saturated k still worse than free-k.
This current-based Q differs from prior local eigenmode Q; the earlier claim that k cannot change effective Q in passband was incomplete.
